record.name: Twenty
record.one_liner: Twenty is an open-source CRM that technical teams can extend and customize using TypeScript, REST and GraphQL APIs, webhooks, and OAuth.

auth.notes: Twenty implements OAuth 2.0 with authorization code + PKCE for user-facing apps and client credentials for server-to-server access, as well as API keys for internal scripts and automation.

access.notes: Users can start a free trial or sign up for Cloud in under a minute without a credit card, and clients are registered dynamically per RFC 7591.

api_surface.notes: Twenty supports REST and GraphQL APIs, webhooks, a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, and TypeScript extensions.
